findings.evidence: docs/modules/auth/overview.md contains no mention of 'secret' or 'NEXTAUTH' anywhere in its full text (Purpose, Responsibilities, Boundaries, Key Entities, Dependencies, Dependents sections). The claim actually originates in docs/modules/auth/deployment.md ('NextAuth-based credential authentication typically requires a secret ... but no environment-variable reference ... appears in any of the seven files in this dispatch's permitted read set'). Sibling cross-cutting docs docs/cross-cutting/error-handling.md ('No other environment variable names (for example a NextAuth secret) ... are confirmed in the five module overviews or README.md') and docs/cross-cutting/configuration.md ('No other environment variable (for example a NextAuth signing secret) is named in any of the five module overviews or README.md') both explicitly state that none of the five module overviews name this, directly contradicting the attribution.
findings.locationHint: One required environment variable is grounded in the [persistence overview](../modules/persistence/overview.md): the module "fail[s] fast at module load if `DATABASE_URL` is not set" (`src/lib/db.ts`). [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] No naming convention for environment variables, and no other required variables (for example a NextAuth secret, which the [auth overview](../modules/auth/overview.md) separately flags as unconfirmed), are documented in the synthesized inputs.
findings.message: This line attributes the 'NextAuth secret unconfirmed' flag to the auth overview (../modules/auth/overview.md), but that document never mentions a NextAuth secret; the flag actually appears in docs/modules/auth/deployment.md, a different document not linked here. Sibling cross-cutting docs (error-handling.md, configuration.md) state the opposite: that none of the five module overviews name this variable at all.
